text:
priya: Hey team — PR ready for release cut, needs quick eyes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321. Blocker: we need changelog entry + release:ready label + backport to release-1.2 before cut at 14:00 UTC. small diff, tests mostly green but one flaky gpu-test. Please ping if you can review/merge. @release-team
sam: grabbing it now, will aim to review in 15-20m :eyes:
jordan: can do changelog check. Is there a specific entry format?
priya: add under 'Bug fixes' with one-liner: 'Fix crash during kv-cache eviction on long sequences (PR #4321)'. Also add 'backports: release-1.2' in PR body so release tooling picks it up.
release-bot: Reminder: Cut window opens in 2h (14:00 UTC). Current merge queue length: 3. Ensure PR has label release:ready and CI green.
oliver: quick note — CI failing on gpu-integration-test. Locally looks like a seed-dependent race at TestKVCache. I pushed small retry in test, but I can also re-run CI if you want.
priya: thanks oliver — if you can push the test retry, do that. Otherwise I'll request a re-run after approvals.
sam: code looks fine, left one nits comment re: a log level. LGTM after that. I can hit merge button once CI passes and release:ready label present.
devops: heads up — merges into main during cut window require 'merge-queue' label and approval from release-owner. If you want automatic backport, add 'cherry-pick:release-1.2' label.
priya: done — added changelog and requested review from @sam, added labels `release:ready` and `cherry-pick:release-1.2`. Re-run of CI queued. Thanks!
sam: re-run passed, merging now. :rocket:
release-bot: Merge succeeded. Backport PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4322
priya: amazing, thanks all :tada:
